AIR TRANSPORTATION
The China National Aviation Corporation, pio-
neers of commercial air transportation in China.
have had three years experience in operating the
Yangtze River air line.
Amphibian type planes are used-permits landing
on land or water.
ill planes are manned by air transport pilots
e: h with thousands of hours flying experience.
One continuous landing field along the entire
route-the great Yangtze River.
C.N.A.C. maintains its own radio stations for
the purpose
of accurately informing the pilots
before take-offs
regarding
the
latest
weather
conditions provided by trained meteorologists.
Efficient and long-experienced operating and
mechanical personnel keep planes in first-class
flying condition.
A highly systematized inspection
occurs before and after each flight.

BAGGAGE: 25 Ibs. of baggage will be car-

carried
whenever possible and depending upon

STOP-OVERS: Ten-day stop-overs will be
allowed on all tickets provided reservations are
made in advance.
CANCELLATIONS: The corporation
will
make no refunds unless space is cancelled 36 hours
before departure of plane.
If cancelled on less
than 36 hours notice refunds will only be made
if space is resold or in the event there are unsold
seats remaining
in the plane at the time of
departure.

provides free transportation between its offices
and airports.

the fare.
